responsibility: Implements generic CFG analysis utilities that query graph structure without being tied to one IL representation. Its responsibilities include DFS-based backedge marking and verification, reachability marking and unreachable-block checks, edge-list and control-dependence support, postorder/reverse-postorder and DFS enumeration helpers, dominance-frontier and iterated-dominance-frontier computations, predecessor/successor bitmap set operations for dataflow solvers, and structural queries such as single-predecessor ordering or ignoring loop-backedge predecessors.
same_name_distinction: Contains the executable generic CFG analyses—DFS backedge marking, reachability, traversal orders, dominance-frontier/IDF computation, and bitmap predecessor/successor operations—whereas gcc/cfganal.h only publishes those analysis types and function declarations.
